scope: Selected canonical RPG.GameCore.ModifySPNew post-commit BP contributions only. This is a generic reference bridge, not the complete SkillCharacterComponent action/resource runtime.

selected_model.holder: The ModifySPNew target alias identifies an entity whose team owns the shared SkillPointEntity-equivalent TeamSkillPointState.
selected_model.transition: Evaluate the payload with the unified DynamicValue resolver, discard a non-positive evaluated contribution, otherwise add it to the team holder and clamp to [0, maximum].
selected_model.ordering: This is RESOURCE_POST_COMMIT only. BP cost/gate and action scheduling are deliberately not smuggled into a modifier callback operation.

evidence.support: shared holder, legality/cost/gain model and before/after-use boundaries
complete MCommon_HOT_SP callback execution and cap clamp

dsh_implementation_contract: Maintain one bounded shared BP holder per team. Resolve operation target aliases only to locate that holder. Never create an entity-local BP field and never interpret a negative ModifySPNew contribution as an SP spend. Implement skill cost/gate at the action boundary separately.
